title: Quantitative assays to measure the transport activity of the mitochondrial calcium uniporter in cell lines or Xenopus oocytes
protocol: Fill 12 scintillation vials with 5 mL of WB and place them on ice.
Set up the vacuum filtration manifold using 0.45 μm pore size round nitrocellulose membranes.
Connect the manifold to a vacuum outlet or a vacuum pump.
Pass 5 mL of water through each membrane to confirm vacuum power and wet the membrane.
Prepare 1000× digitonin (30 mM in water).
Prepare 500× thapsigargin (2.5 mM in DMSO).
Add 0.6 μL of concentrated 45Ca2+ stock to 0.6 mL of RB.
Add 30-μM digitonin and 5-μM thapsigargin to the solution.
Split the solution into two microcentrifuge tubes.
Label one tube as tube A (no Ru360) and the other as tube B (with Ru360).
Add 100 nM Ru360 to tube B.
Trypsinize HEK293T cells in two wells of a 6-well plate.
Resuspend trypsinized cells in 2–4 mL of DMEM with 10% FBS.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer or an automatic cell counter.
Transfer 4 × 10^6 cells to a microcentrifuge tube.
Spin down the cells at 2000 g for 1 minute.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of WB and spin down again at 2000 g for 1 minute.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 200 μL of WB supplemented with digitonin and thapsigargin.
Allow the cells to be permeabilized for at least 2 minutes.
Add 100 μL of cell suspension to tube A.
Mix well to start mitochondrial 45Ca2+ uptake.
After 1 minute, add 100 μL of remaining cell suspension to tube B to start 45Ca2+ uptake in this tube.
Transfer 100 μL of each sample into respective scintillation vials with ice-cold WB at 2 minutes after the start of uptake.
Repeat the transfer for samples at 4 and 6 minutes.
Immediately filter the mix through a vacuum manifold.
Filter the solution through to remove extramitochondrial 45Ca2+.
Transfer membranes into empty scintillation vials.
Add 15 mL scintillation cocktail for counting to each vial containing membranes.
Transfer 10 μL of remaining solutions from tube A and tube B into different scintillation vials.
Add 15-mL scintillation cocktail for counting to the vials with remaining solutions.
Shake the scintillation vials vigorously for at least 30 seconds.
Repeat steps involving filtration, membrane transfer, and scintillation cocktail addition for technical replicates.
Measure counts (CPM) in each vial using a scintillation counter.
Calculate the average of two readings for each time point to generate a single data point.
Multiply the signal from 10 μL of remaining solution by 10 to obtain total signal in 100 μL solution.
Linearize 10 μg of pOX vector containing human MCU-EMRE fusion construct using NotI-HF restriction enzyme.
Digest hME-pOX for 6 hours at 37°C.
Heat inactivate the sample for 20 minutes at 65°C using a thermal cycler.
Run the linearization reaction on a 1% DNA gel to confirm complete linearization of the hME vector.
Purify the fully linearized DNA using a Qiagen PCR purification kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Use a mMessage mMachine T3 transcription kit to produce cRNA, following the manufacturer’s protocol with 1 μg of linearized DNA as the template.
Digest the DNA template after cRNA synthesis using the Turbo DNase provided in the T3 transcription kit.
Purify the synthesized cRNA using the Qiagen RNeasy MinElute kit according to the manufacturer's protocols.
Elute the purified cRNA with 20-30 μL of RNase free water.
Check the quality of RNA by standard RNA gel electrophoresis under denaturation conditions.
Rinse the ovary lobes three times with ND96.
Fill a 50 mL conical tube with 20 mL of DB.
Cut the ovaries into lentil-sized chunks in the tube until oocytes fill a volume of 5-10 mL.
Rinse oocytes with DB multiple times until the buffer runs clear.
Dissolve 12.5 mg of type II collagenase in 10 mL of DB.
Digest oocytes at 25°C for 30 min using all the solution.
Discard the digestion solution and rinse oocytes multiple times with fresh DB until the buffer runs clear.
Repeat step 30, 2-3 more times, until the follicle layer is fully digested.
Check under a stereoscope to ensure the follicle layer is mostly gone.
Rinse with DB until the solution is clear.
Wash oocytes 3–4 times with 20 mL of ND96.
Transfer digested oocytes to multiple 10-cm tissue-culture dishes containing ND96, ensuring less than 100 oocytes per dish.
Store the dishes at 17°C for 12–24 hours before cRNA injection.
Ensure that oocytes are completely submerged in ND96.
Select healthy stage V-VI oocytes with a diameter of approximately 1 mm.
Transfer selected oocytes to new dishes with ND96.
Inject these oocytes with 30-60 ng of cRNA using a microinjector.
Transfer injected oocytes into 6-well plates containing ND96 at a density of 5 oocytes per well.
Change the buffer daily.
Remove dead oocytes regularly.
Discard buffers that contain debris from oocytes.
Maintain oocytes for two-electrode voltage clamp or patch-clamp experiments after 3-5 days post-cRNA injection.
